# Supplier Exit Verification

## Purpose

Verify that supplier offboarding actually completed the intended access, data, billing, contract, and dependency cleanup.

## Requirements

Material exits SHOULD confirm access removal, credential/key changes where required, data return or deletion obligations, retained-record decisions, billing termination, replacement ownership, unresolved incidents, and completion evidence.

A cancellation request alone is not closure evidence.
